name: Run test suite
description: Manually runs the full Vitest suite (npm test, already --run) on demand. This hook is user-triggered only: it fires solely when you click its button in the Kiro Agent Hooks panel. It has no automatic trigger — it never runs on file save, on any agent event, or on a schedule — so it cannot fire on its own or consume credits unattended.

then.prompt: Run the project's full test suite by executing `npm test` (which already passes vitest --run) from the workspace root. Report the pass/fail summary. Do not modify any files.
